tip: あう (meet) and かい (会社) matter most. 会う is for meeting people; 合う (to fit) is a different kanji.
おなじ is the key word for N5/N4. どう shows up in compounds like 同時.
じ (食事) and 仕事 are the big ones. こと becomes ごと after another word, as in 仕事.
じ is the main reading: 自分, 自転車. Watch 自然, which uses し instead.
しゃ is the reading to know: 会社, 社長. In 神社 (shrine) it changes to じゃ.
はつ is the main reading, but its sound often changes: 出発 しゅっぱつ, 発表 はっぴょう.
しゃ is the one you need: 医者. Do not mix up 者 with 暑 (hot), which has 日 on top.
Both readings are common: ち in 地図, じ in 地震. Learn them word by word.
ぎょう is all you need for N4: 授業, 卒業.
かた means person or way of doing (読み方), ほう means direction or side. In 夕方 it becomes がた.
Learn あたらしい and しん (新聞). 新しい keeps しい outside the kanji.
ば (場所, 場合) and じょう (会場, 工場) are both common. Places for a purpose often use じょう: 駐車場.
Only いん. Add it to a place to make a worker: 店員, 会社員. Do not mix up 員 (口 on top) with 買 (buy).
たつ (stand) is the N5 word. りつ often becomes りっ, as in 立派.
For N5 learn あく and あける. 開く can be read あく or ひらく, so check the context.
て is the main reading. Traps: 上手 is じょうず and 下手 is へた.
ちから is the word; りょく appears in compounds like 努力. Do not confuse 力 with katakana カ.
もん is what you need: 問題, 質問. Do not mix up 問 (口 inside) with 聞 (耳 inside) or 間 (日 inside).
だい is the main on reading: 時代. 代わる means to take someone's place; do not mix it up with 変わる (to change).
あかるい and めい (説明) matter most. 明日 is usually read あした, a special reading.
うごく and どう (動物, 運動) are both key. Do not confuse 動 with 働 (work), which adds 亻.
Only きょう matters: 東京, 京都.
め (eye) is the N5 word. As a suffix it shows order: 一番目, 二つ目.
Learn かよう (commute), とおる (pass) and つう (交通, 普通). Spell it とおり, not とうり.
いう and ことば are the ones for N5/N4. 言う sounds like ゆう but is written いう.
Only り: 料理, 理由. 理 is 王 plus 里 (village).
からだ (body) is the N5 word; たい appears in 大体. Do not mix up 体 (亻 + 本) with 休 (rest, 亻 + 木).
た is the one to know; in names it often becomes だ (山田). 田舎 has a special reading: いなか (countryside).
しゅ (主人) and おも (主に) are the useful ones. ご主人 means someone else's husband.
Only だい: 問題, 宿題.
Only い: 意味, 注意. 意 is 音 (sound) over 心 (heart).
Mostly ふ, meaning not: 不便 is not convenient. ぶ is rare (不器用).
つくる is the N5 word. さく (作文) and さ (作業) sound close, so learn them word by word.
よう is what you need: 用事, 用意. もちいる is formal writing.
ど is the key reading, for times and degrees: 一度, 今度. 支度 (getting ready) uses たく.
つよい and べんきょう are N5 words. 勉強 means study, even though 強 means strong.
こう is the reading to know: 公園.
もつ is the main reading: 持つ, 気持ち. じ only appears in harder words like 維持.
や is the one for N4: 野菜, 野球. の appears in 野原 and many names.
Only い, in 以上 (or more) and 以下 (or less). Both include the number itself.
おもう is the N4 word. 思い出 is おもいで, but 思い出す is おもいだす.
いえ, うち and か (家族) all matter. In 作家 and 画家, 家 means a person who does that job.
せ is the N4 reading: 世界, お世話. せい is for 世紀 (century).
おおい and たぶん are the ones to know. 多い is おおい, not おうい.
ただしい and しょう (お正月) matter at N4. せい appears in 正解 (correct answer).
やすい (cheap) and あん (安心) are both key. やすい means cheap, not easy (easy is 易しい やさしい).
Only いん: 病院. Do not confuse 病院 (hospital) with 美容院 (hair salon).
こころ and しん (心配, 安心) are the ones to learn.
Only かい, and 世界 is the word you need.
おしえる (teach) and きょう (教室) matter most. おそわる is the other side: to be taught.
ぶん is the main reading. 注文 (order) uses もん, a common trap.
げん in 元気 is the N5 word. 元日 (New Year's Day) uses がん.
おもい (heavy) is the N4 word. じゅう appears in 体重, ちょう in 貴重 (precious).
ちかい and きん (近所, 最近) are both N4 must knows.
かんがえる is the one to learn. Do not mix up 考 with 老 (old).
が (映画) and かく (計画) are both N4. Learn which word uses which reading.
うみ (sea) is the N5 word; かい appears in 海外 (overseas). 海 is water (氵) plus 毎.
うる (sell) is the key word. Its opposite is 買う (buy), which also has ばい as its on reading.
しる is the N5 word. Say 知っています for 'I know', and 知りません for 'I don't know'.
みち (road) is the N5 word; どう appears in 水道 and 柔道.
あつまる (things gather) and あつめる (you collect them) are both N4.
べつ (特別) and わかれる matter. Do not mix up 別れる (part from someone) with 分かれる (split into parts).
もの and ぶつ (動物) are both common. 荷物 (luggage) uses もつ, a classic trap.
つかう is the N5 word; し appears in 大使館 (embassy). Do not mix up 使 with 便 (as in 便利).
ひん (作品) and しな (品物) are the two readings. 品 is three 口 shapes stacked.
けい is the main reading: 時計 (clock), 計画.
しぬ is the N4 word. Both readings are し, so it is easy to read.
Only とく: 特に, 特別. In 特急 it becomes とっ.
わたし is the N5 word; わたくし is the polite form. 私立 (private school) uses し.
はじめる and はじまる are both N4. Do not mix up 始める with 初めて (for the first time).
あさ is the N5 reading. 今朝 has a special reading: けさ (this morning).
うん (運転, 運動) and はこぶ (carry) are both N4.
おわる is the N5 word. しゅう appears in 終電 (last train).
だい is also the counter for cars and machines: 一台. 台風 (typhoon) uses たい.
ひろい (wide) is the N4 word. こう appears in 広告 (advert).
すむ and じゅう (住所) are the N4 ones. Say 住んでいます for 'I live in'.
しん in 写真 is the N5 word. ま means right or pure: 真ん中 (the very middle).
ゆう in 有名 is the reading to know. ある is usually written in kana, not 有る.
くち is the N5 word. It becomes ぐち after another word: 入口, 出口.
すこし and すくない are both N5; watch the different okurigana. Do not mix up 少 with 小 (small).
まち (town) is the N5 word. In addresses, 〜町 is often read ちょう.
Only りょう: 料理, 料金. Do not mix up 料 (米 on the left) with 科 (禾 on the left).
こう is the main reading: 工場. 大工 (carpenter) and 工夫 use く.
